messages:
Iris Cole: dropping a fresh mock for a 'mini slate' control that sits above the composer during streaming. it's a compact horizontal bar with: a tiny token meter, an Interrupt icon, and a Regen chevron that expands into 'Restart & Replace' or 'Resume & Continue'. curious about copy and a11y implications.
Marco Diaz: interesting pattern. two quick things: 1) language: 'Interrupt' vs 'Stop' — +1 for Interrupt. 2) "Restart & Replace" might sound destructive. maybe 'Restart generation' instead?
Yara Ibrahim: agree with Marco. also for screen readers we need explicit labels per action. recommend aria-labels: 'Interrupt streaming', 'Regenerate: restart generation', and when the chevron expands expose the two choices as radio-like buttons.
Theo Brooks: dev constraints: expanding chevron adds complexity. alternative: long-press on Regen opens a small menu with the two options. simpler to implement cross-platform.
Iris Cole: long-press is neat on touch, but desktop discoverability drops. maybe show hint: "⌥ click for options" in the tooltip.
Marco Diaz: token meter: product wants live tokens while streaming but infra prefers throttled updates. compromise: UI shows rough bucketed values like '~50 tok' updating every 600ms; exact count only after finish. also add an estimated token badge when selecting a prompt in the library: 'Est. 38 tok'.
Yara Ibrahim: a11y: token meter should be aria-hidden while streaming. after completion announce once: 'Generation complete, 42 tokens'. avoid intermediate announcements. for the mini slate, ensure the Interrupt button returns focus to the composer and that the composer gets an announcement: 'Generation interrupted'.
Theo Brooks: implementation note: interrupt should abort the request but keep the in-memory context (KV cache). restart should clear the generation state but keep user context. that'll be the default behavior.
Iris Cole: copy micro-iteration: chevron menu options: 'Restart generation' and 'Resume generation'. Regen button tooltip: 'Regenerate response (Ctrl+.)'. also show a small inline confirmation for destructive-sounding actions: subtle 'This restarts output' message in the mini-slate.
Marco Diaz: color/contrast: mini-slate background is semi-transparent right now. ramp to full surface token for better contrast; add 3px focus ring in accent color. ensure icons meet 4.5:1.
Yara Ibrahim: motion: the token meter tick animates; respect prefers-reduced-motion by switching to fade-only or no animation. also helpful to expose an option in accessibility settings to disable live token updates.
Theo Brooks: keyboard: Esc still aborts but collides with some editors; add Ctrl+. / Cmd+. as alternative and surface both in tooltips. also bind Shift+Enter to 'Restart generation' when composer focused and there's a previous generation.
Iris Cole: prompt library tie-in: for prompts with variables show a preflight card when user hits run: small overlay 'Est. 45 tok • Might take ~2s'. add a subtle toggle 'Show exact token estimate' for advanced users.
Marco Diaz: telemetry: batch token telemetry every 10s; emit events for interrupt/restart/resume and which menu option was chosen. add a 'token_estimate_shown' flag to track uptake.
Yara Ibrahim: I'll draft the accessibility checklist: aria-live announcements only on end/interrupt, focus management back to composer, screen-reader phrasing for menu options, no intermediate token SR announcements, focus trap for expanded menu.
Theo Brooks: I'll prototype the long-press vs chevron menu flows and hook up the keyboard mapping. will post a short gif of interactions.
AssistBot: figma saved by Iris Cole at 1769508250  https://www.figma.com/file/mini-slate/mock (private).
Iris Cole: thanks everyone  I'll update the figma with the copy tweaks and the 'Show exact token estimate' toggle and loop back for a quick validation pass. :sparkles:
